about: Our fixes to a base tag, applied by sprapply.py right after it copies the base to the SPR name and before the SPR values (the fixes-first rule, 2026-11-06). Keyed by the SPR tag's kit file. Ops: remove_named = remove the element of <block> whose <field> equals <value>; value = set a field (plugin path as tagfields writes it, value as [kind, value]) the way the walk's SPR values are set (mapped to H3EK's name, written, read back).

objects\\vehicles\\lich\\lich_spr.model.why: RJ's unfinished H5 variant: most exterior textures missing, see-through in Forge (host on LG Forge, 2026-11-23). PR offers each variant as its own Forge entry, so it went too.

objects\\vehicles\\lich\\lich_spr.vehicl.why: LG fix, fit_spheres.py 'split' (2026-11-20/21): the flip prompt outranks every action, so the Lich's flip sphere is fitted to its model (20.0 + 0.25, was 32).
LG fix, fit_spheres.py 'split': the fitted sphere's centre (was 11, 2, 3.5, off the model).

LG fix, fit_spheres.py 'split': the cluster sphere (seat entry, pickups, drawing, blasts) keeps the radius it had before fitting (host 2026-11-21: pilot seats stopped being offered when both spheres shrank).
